corrections.historical_claim: Blender 5.3 is alpha; release due 10 November; daily hand-download needed.
corrections.replacement: Blender 5.3.0 was released on 10 November 2026. Blender 5.2.4 is the current 5.2 LTS patch on that date. Keep the 5.2 LTS and 5.3 native-splat lanes separately pinned.
corrections.next_action: Replace the historical future-release task with a stable 5.3 CI/probe task. Do not infer PyPI wheel availability from the executable release.

corrections.historical_claim: radiance:base is opacity followed by base color.
corrections.replacement: Blender stores raw SH degree-zero coefficients in radiance:base.xyz, followed by activated opacity in w. The new four-splat native 5.3 test reproduces this mapping and all 15 higher-degree RGB coefficient slots.
corrections.next_action: Keep asymmetric known-answer splats. Treat SH basis, channel order, opacity activation and scale activation as separate declared mappings.

corrections.historical_claim: Blender 5.3 native import/render implies complete splat interchange.
corrections.replacement: Native import and rendering are available in Blender 5.3; the official notes state that native export is absent. The new structural test reproduces native PLY import, a fork X3D 4.1 round trip and a loss of covariance under Apply Transform.
corrections.next_action: Keep native import, fork export, rendering and transform preservation as separate capabilities. This four-splat structural test does not complete the B01 renderer or scale ladder.

corrections.historical_claim: SH degree 3 has 59 numbers and occupies 248 bytes in PLY.
corrections.replacement: SH degree 3 uses 59 model scalars, or 236 bytes at float32. The common reference PLY adds three normal scalars, yielding 62 float32 properties and 248 bytes per vertex, before the header.
corrections.next_action: Name the property list, scalar width, endianness and header separately. Preserve the 68/104/164/248-byte table only for this declared layout.

corrections.historical_claim: 32-bit versus 64-bit means six versus fifteen orders of magnitude.
corrections.replacement: This distinction concerns significant precision, not exponent range. Reopened Blender 5.2.4 mesh coordinates matched float32 quantization in two metric coordinate controls. Local-origin storage substantially reduced the measured errors.
corrections.next_action: Retain 64-bit source coordinates and reversible origin/units metadata. Budget absolute error at the actual coordinate magnitude.

corrections.historical_claim: Standard is universally value-correct and X_ITE is unmanaged sRGB-ish.
corrections.replacement: Standard avoids an additional creative view transform, but display conversion, material lighting, exposure and alpha still affect pixels. X_ITE exposes colorSpace, displayColorSpace and toneMapping controls.
corrections.next_action: Pin both color pipelines. Use unlit known-color charts for quantitative comparison and retain beauty renders as a separate view.

corrections.historical_claim: Non-Color should be used for every scientific image.
corrections.replacement: Tag numeric data maps as Non-Color. An already encoded display colormap is color data and needs its declared encoding rather than automatic Non-Color tagging.
corrections.next_action: Record scalar units and the transfer function separately from RGB encodings. The second sentence is an interpretation of the documented color pipeline.

corrections.historical_claim: X3D has no carrier for per-point attributes beyond Color and Metadata.
corrections.replacement: X3D has named FloatVertexAttribute and matrix vertex attributes for shaders, plus typed Metadata. These carriers do not automatically provide scientific meaning or an equivalent of a Geometry Nodes graph.
corrections.next_action: Define attributes with a name, data association, component count, units, missing-value mask and display mapping. Check the supported runtime profile.

corrections.historical_claim: X3D has no concept of atoms, bonds or interactions.
corrections.replacement: The core is not a molecular analysis ontology, but Web3D already supplies CML-to-X3D molecular prototype examples. Preserve domain identities through PROTO/Metadata and a molecular sidecar.
corrections.next_action: Reuse the established chemical mapping direction before proposing new Atom/Bond core nodes. Retain source PDB, mmCIF or CML identifiers.

corrections.historical_claim: Blender visualizes; it does not analyze.
corrections.assessment: useful policy stated as a false absolute
corrections.replacement: Treat independently checked scientific arrays as authoritative. Blender Python and Geometry Nodes can perform analysis; those computations still need units, validation and reproducible reference checks.
corrections.next_action: Separate numerical authority from presentation authority by contract rather than by application name.

corrections.historical_claim: Splats are for viewing; meshes are for measuring and simulation.
corrections.replacement: A radiance field is not automatically a validated surface, and a mesh is not automatically a measurement. Analytical suitability depends on acquisition, reconstruction, calibration and uncertainty.
corrections.next_action: Grade each representation against its intended task and retain its reconstruction assumptions.

corrections.historical_claim: The stock extension and modern fork can be aggregated as one X3D capability.
corrections.replacement: The official extension advertises X3D 3.3. Current local Blender 5.2.4 fixtures test stock commit a173dfb and fork commit 044bea3 separately. Both execute, while their recorded preservation losses differ.
corrections.next_action: Use the current bounded loss tables. Do not transfer one route's capabilities or losses to another route.

corrections.historical_claim: PLY is lossless; SPZ is 10× smaller; SOG is 15–20× smaller.
corrections.assessment: depends on the storage profile and corpus
corrections.replacement: PLY property types and the writer determine precision. SPZ documents quantization. Compression ratios and fidelity must be measured for the exact codec settings and corpus.
corrections.next_action: Report decoded position, scale, angular and SH errors alongside bytes. A ZSTD container does not imply lossless model storage.

corrections.historical_claim: KHR_gaussian_splatting was ratified on 3 September 2026, based only on trade press.
corrections.assessment: status strengthened; exact historical date unverified
corrections.replacement: The current Khronos primary README marks the base extension Complete/Ratified. This does not verify the 3 September date or ratify every dependent compression extension.
corrections.next_action: Pin a committed specification revision. Test quaternion order, linear/log scale and opacity activation on each route.

corrections.historical_claim: pLDDT lives in the B-factor column.
corrections.replacement: AlphaFold downloads store pLDDT in B-factor fields. Do not reinterpret arbitrary experimental PDB B-factors as pLDDT. Local confidence does not establish correct relative chain placement.
corrections.next_action: Require producer and field-semantic metadata. Test the confidence-band boundary values explicitly.

corrections.historical_claim: Saving AOVs turns a render into a measurement.
corrections.replacement: AOVs are numeric outputs of a rendering process. Scientific measurement requires defined units, conventions, calibration and validation against the claimed quantity.
corrections.next_action: Record the camera, depth convention, color encoding, sample count/seed, masks and display mapping. Keep raw buffers with the figure.

corrections.historical_claim: Every position, scale, rotation, opacity and SH value should round-trip within an absolute 1e-6 float32 tolerance.
corrections.replacement: Use quantity-specific absolute and relative tolerances. Compare quaternion rotations modulo q/−q, covariance under basis changes, and SH after the declared basis and rotation mapping.
corrections.next_action: Attach units and a tolerance rationale to each witness. Distinguish serialization quantization from display error.

corrections.historical_claim: OpenUSD 26.03 contains a Gaussian splat schema.
corrections.replacement: AOUSD's 26.03 announcement identifies the ParticleField schema family, including UsdVolParticleField3DGaussianSplat. Schema availability does not prove any particular Blender import/export path.
corrections.next_action: Preserve this positive interoperability link, but require an executed fixture before claiming adapter capability.

corrections.historical_claim: Local-origin handling is a new ad hoc workaround required at every X3D border.
corrections.replacement: X3D's Geospatial design already uses GeoCoordinate double-precision coordinates and local origins. The new Blender probe supplies bounded storage measurements for the authoring hub.
corrections.next_action: Map the original CRS and local frame to established standards where applicable. Never infer a CRS from coordinate magnitude.

corrections.historical_claim: Every kind of Confirmed claim requires both a named validator and an X_ITE patch.
corrections.assessment: one grade mixes independent evidence axes
corrections.replacement: Record claim type, source quality, executed scope, artifact identity, falsification controls and freshness separately. A release fact can be primary-checked without a renderer; schema validity cannot confirm domain truth.
corrections.next_action: Keep the historical grades unchanged. Add structured evidence facets rather than silently upgrading every claim after one new test.

corrections.historical_claim: Drug-discovery outcomes, product licenses, quotas and add-on versions are live facts.
corrections.replacement: Retain these historical claims as dated research notes. They are not refreshed by this technical review and must not be promoted as current medical, legal or commercial guidance.
corrections.next_action: Create separate source-specific review tasks when the corresponding molecular or licensed-asset workflow is selected.

scope: Review of the supplied KB notes, primary documentation, existing Research Loom receipts, a new Blender 5.2.4 precision probe and a four-splat native Blender 5.3 structural/data probe.
